lines.text: David lifts up his soul to the LORD and says those who wait for Him will not be put to shame.
David asks the LORD to teach him His paths and to remember His compassion and loving devotion.
Because the LORD is good and upright, He shows priests the way and guides the humble in what is right.
The man who fears the LORD will dwell in prosperity, and his enemies will inherit the land.
David asks the LORD to take away all his sins and to redeem Israel from all its distress.
